'''Xot''' was the owner of a three-story [[Xot's Megabar|bar]] located near the [[Belgar Spaceport|spaceport]] of the city of [[Belgar]] on the planet [[Belgaroth]]. His identity was shrouded in mystery: over the years, more than three dozen beings of various [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Gender/Legends|genders]] had visited the bar, each claiming to be Xot. No one knew whether he was a [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifter]] or if the truth was something far more complicated. In any case, it seemed that few cared. Local criminal elements often frequented Xot's bar and were well informed about all the underworld affairs of Belgaroth.
